name: Phoenix Fan Fusion
blurb: Formerly Phoenix Comicon: Arizona's biggest pop-culture convention at the Phoenix Convention Center, with celebrity panels, comics, gaming and cosplay.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'June 4 - 6th, 2027 Phoenix Convention Center Discover Your Inner Geek!'

notes: Guests nav links to a dedicated 'Guests Coming Soon' page whose own text says: 'Guests Coming SooN! Our 2027 show is already shaping up to be one for the multiverse. Check back soon for our first round of guest announcements...' so guests is 'none-yet'; the 'Previously, on Fan Fusion... 2026' section on that same page is an explicit past-years archive (2026 Celebrities/Comic Creators/Authors/Cosplay/etc.), not the 2027 lineup, so it was not used. Passes/tickets are also not yet on sale ('Passes on sale soon - Check back in the new year'), so tickets is left blank rather than guessed. No og:image on the site; cover uses the plain transparent Fan Fusion logo mark since the other available images are either sponsor logos or last year's (FF26-prefixed) photos. Organizer confirmed via search: 'owned, produced and managed by Square Egg Entertainment Inc. (SEEI), DBA PHOENIX FAN FUSION LLC', matching the seed.
